description: E41 — 尼姆佐印度古典变例，大兵链vs根部反击

intro.popup_en:
Pawn-Chain Direction, Practice 8
The Nimzo-Indian idea: ...Bb4 pins Nc3 and disrupts White's plan to build a broad pawn center. Black immediately challenges the base of the chain with ...c5.
intro.popup:
兵链方向练习8
尼姆佐印度！
核心思想：
Bb4钉住Nc3
→破坏白方建立大兵链
c5立刻攻d4根部
——Nimzo核心！

outro.popup_en: Summary: ...g5 drives the bishop from h4 to g3, where Black exchanges it. White then pushes d5-d6, restricting the knight on c6 and creating a dangerous passed pawn. Qd4 joins the pressure, leaving White with a clear positional advantage.
outro.popup:
总结：Bh4被g5逐走 → Bg3换象 → d5-d6兵链强推
Qd4中心化！白方位置优势不可挡！

moves.popup_en: ...Bb4! The Nimzo-Indian pin on Nc3 disrupts White's plan to build the c4-d4-e3 pawn chain. This is the core strategic idea of the Nimzo-Indian.
moves.popup:
Bb4！Nimzo！钉住Nc3
准备破坏c4-d4-e3白方兵链
——尼姆佐核心战略！

moves.popup_en: e3 completes White's intended c4-d4-e3 pawn chain.
moves.popup: e3建立c4-d4-e3兵链

moves.popup_en: ...c5! Black attacks the base of the chain at d4 immediately, putting the Nimzo-Indian idea into practice.
moves.popup:
c5！c5攻根部！黑立刻冲击d4
——Nimzo核心思想实践！

moves.popup_en: ...cxd4 exchanges at the base of White's pawn chain.
moves.popup: cxd4！兑换根部

moves.popup_en: d5!! White advances to establish a new pawn chain, answering Black's pressure on d4 with a space-gaining push.
moves.popup:
d5！！白方d5推进！建立新兵链
用d5来回答黑方对d4的压力

moves.popup_en: a3 challenges the bishop on b4.
moves.popup: a3驱逐Bb4

moves.popup_en: ...Bd6 retreats the bishop.
moves.popup: Bd6象撤退

moves.popup_en: ...dxc4 strikes at the base of White's chain on c4, demonstrating the importance of attacking the pawn-chain base.
moves.popup: dxc4！黑打击c4根部！根部突破战略！

moves.popup_en: Re1 activates White's rooks.
moves.popup: Re1双车激活

moves.popup_en: ...g5 expands on the kingside and forces White's bishop away from h4.
moves.popup: g5！黑方王翼扩张，逼走白象Bh4

moves.popup_en: Bg3 retreats to safety while keeping control of d6.
moves.popup: Bg3！白象撤守g3，保持对d6格的控制

moves.popup_en: ...Bxg3 exchanges Black's bishop for White's bishop.
moves.popup: Bxg3！黑方主动换象，消除白象

moves.popup_en: Nxg3 recaptures and stabilizes White's kingside.
moves.popup: Nxg3！白马复夺g3，王翼结构巩固

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 returns the knight to increase pressure on d4.
moves.popup: Nc6！黑马重返c6，向d4继续施压

moves.popup_en: d5!! White advances the pawn chain, restricting Black's knight on c6 and creating a powerful passed pawn.
moves.popup:
d5！！白方兵链强推！
封锁黑方c6马，建立强大过路兵

moves.popup_en: ...Ne7 retreats the knight, outside the pawn's control.
moves.popup: Ne7！黑马撤回a避开d5控制范围

moves.popup_en: d6!! The passed pawn penetrates deep into Black's position and threatens the queenside.
moves.popup:
d6！！白方前锋深入黑阵！
d6过路兵直逼黑方后翼

moves.popup_en: ...Ng6 tries to maneuver against the advanced d-pawn.
moves.popup: Ng6！黑马机动，试图限制d6兵前进

moves.popup_en: Qd4 centralizes the queen and coordinates with the pawn on d6 to create strong pressure. White's position is clearly superior.
moves.popup:
Qd4！白后强占d4中心！
与d6兵联动形成强大压力
白方局面优势明显！

moves.popup_en: ...Nh4 looks for counterplay, but White's positional advantage is already decisive.
moves.popup:
Nh4！黑马跳入h4，但白方优势已无法挽回
白方兵链战术完胜！
